trigger: The sanitized scanner found three address occurrences across two company-documentation paths.

whys.answer: An address value was copied into more than one operational and planning document.
Those documents did not distinguish public mailing, legal-entity, registered-agent, and private-domicile categories.
No repository scanner blocked address-like values when the documents were authored.
whys.evidence: The reusable scanner and CI gate were introduced by issue 131.

stop_reason: Evidence does not establish who introduced each occurrence or whether every historical copy remains reachable.
immediate_correction: Keep values out of audit evidence and identify exposure paths only.
root_cause_correction: Use classified external secure records and prohibit private-domicile values in repositories.
recurrence_guard: Public identity scanner release gate plus identity-governance sanitization tests
